findings.summary: On the acknowledgement turn the driver keeps a cleared return's earlier rendering while pending_write is set; leaks only after 3d.5 wires on and the route changes. Carried to 3d.5.
Persisted history from pack-less turns and model arguments reaches a stricter route unmasked after a fallback or route change; 3d.5 must refuse a stricter route (plan ruling).
The missing-rendering refusal is a plain ValueError reachable only through a kernel bug; 3d.5 types it and maps it to CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE.
action_result is the one return not built from the pack; it holds ids only today and must stay so.
Adapter tests import kernel assemble; the on golden must be re-recorded when kernel/context.py rendering changes.
The scripted driver's pack mode maps broad exceptions to facts missing, which could hide a test-double bug.
Suffix non-persistence relies on pydantic-ai 2.54 request-only message reassignment; guarded by tests; rerun on upgrade.
pg and the harness gate are due in the close ritual.
